content.text:
We must choose 2 of {24 ship in East Summer Sea, 27 footman Starfall, 46 knight Starfall}.

We want to preserve ability to hold/capture castles. Starfall contains castle. Losing both land units at Starfall means losing Starfall? Starfall has controlPowerToken null — actually Martell controls starfall only via units (no power token). If both land units die, Starfall becomes uncontrolled (no power token, not home area). That loses a castle region.

Better to preserve at least one land unit at Starfall. Which to keep? Knight (46) strength 2, footman (27) strength 1. But we must remove 2 units total. Options:
- Remove 24 and 27: keep knight at Starfall. Starfall held (one knight). Lose ship in East Summer Sea.
- Remove 24 and 46: keep footman. Weaker.
- Remove 27 and 46: lose both land units at Starfall, keeping only ship. Bad — lose castle.

So remove 24 (ship) and 27 (footman), keep knight 46. That keeps Starfall with a knight (strength 2) and we still have other ships? East Summer Sea ship was the only ship there. Losing it reduces transport but keeps land presence. Actually check: Martell regions include east-summer-sea with ship 24, port-of-sunspear (ship? listed region port-of-sunspear controlled but no units shown in board—it's controlled via... port-of-sunspear has no units listed). So losing ship 24 leaves us no ships at all? port-of-sunspear control without units? Ports controlled via connected land area ownership. Fine.

Keeping the knight is better for holding Starfall (stronger). So destroy 24 and 27.

That's the answer.
